eligibilityPolicy: Fictional named actor and actress credits in selected films and TV series. Self credits, unnamed roles, and non-performers stay out of the eligible set. Production country is not inferred.
freeze: The study window is the 1960 through 2025 cutoff. A later year present in a source file is kept as source data and left out of the window. No 2026 value is estimated.
suppression: An SSA count under 5, or a missing name, sex, and birth year, is suppressed_or_absent with a null count.
